universe_selection: Same fixed 100-symbol liquidity and available-history cohort as protocol_full100_long_history.json; selected without this 4H-line result, but earlier 1D/1W and EMA results were seen
higher_line_source: 4H bars derived from cached 1H candles using four_hour; use only bars whose final 1H source candle precedes the signal candle start
higher_line_rule: last two confirmed high pivots form resistance and last two confirmed low pivots form support; right wing closed before the signal, projected one 4H bar ahead
entry: EMA25 first-touch signal on closed signal-timeframe bar, near projected 4H support with EMA slope bending up for long or near resistance with EMA slope bending down for short; execute next open
exit: opposite EMA25 first-touch signal closes current side even when 4H line blocks replacement entry
control: same EMA25 0.5 ATR signal without 4H line filter, identical candles and costs
primary_evaluation: 100 consecutive closed trades per stock/timeframe/variant; report every rolling window and nonoverlapping blocks with net PnL, wins, win rate, PF and elapsed days
calendar_reports: monthly and yearly diagnostics only, not promotion gates
candidate_policy: no strategy or paper account without at least one complete 100-trade block, cost review and manual TradingView reconciliation
research_status: exploratory because 4H-line hypothesis was chosen after earlier EMA25 line results were seen
